patthana16.44:1.1: ajjhattaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bahiddhā na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, bahiddhā hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhatto na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā dve.
patthana16.44:2.1: ajjhattaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bahiddhā na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, bahiddhā na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhatto na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā dve. ajhattārammaṇaṃ
